name: financial-management
description: 公司财务管理软件 (Tauri + Vue3 + Node.js)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,desktop -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "wait-on -t 60000 http-get://127.0.0.1:17890/api/health && npm run tauri:dev"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @fm/shared && npm run test -w @fm/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @fm/shared && npm run typecheck -w @fm/server && npm run typecheck -w @fm/desktop
